topics.description: The Minnesota fraud scandal involves allegations of large-scale welfare fraud, prompting investigations by state and federal agencies. Governor Tim Walz's decision not to seek reelection has been linked to the scandal.
topics.reason: The scandal's impact on state politics and potential misuse of federal funds

topics.topic: Trump's Freeze on Child Care Funding
topics.description: The Trump administration has frozen $10 billion in child care funding to five states, including Minnesota, citing fraud concerns. This move affects thousands of families relying on these services.
topics.reason: Impact on low-income families and state-level responses to fraud allegations
